global_preconditions.split: exact-QASM hash-grouped frozen outer split; all tuning is outer-train only
global_preconditions.neural_compute: CUDA-enabled framework, three fixed seeds 42/1234/31415, median per test row; retain seed dispersion
global_preconditions.gpu_exclusivity: one GPU timing worker; never train while a timing cell is active
global_preconditions.checkpoint: validate fold 0 or first ten terminal cells before a full run
global_preconditions.terminal_policy: preserve timeout, unsupported, adapter_error, and quality_failed in coverage

scientific_contract: Freeze three representations: source graph, source-plus-compiled hybrid graph, and compiled/transpiled DAG; document every feature and vocabulary.
Use the identical noisy-Aer warm-execution cell, exact-QASM hash groups, outer folds, and labels for all three GNN variants and tabular baselines.
Train neural variants on CUDA; retain 42/1234/31415 outputs. CPU is permitted only for frozen classical baselines.
Do not use family, source path, hash, timing repetition, or post-execution data as a feature.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Materialize and hash the three representation inputs.
Run leakage and shape tests without training.
Prepare a fold-0 command and environment check.
promotion_requirements: CUDA smoke test and fold-0 QA pass for every neural variant.
Five-fold OOF predictions, coverage and same-row pair table on the 162-core panel.
Frontier q10–q16 reported as coverage/scaling unless a separate frozen extrapolation contract is signed.

scientific_contract: Freeze an approximation ladder per engine/configuration before measurement.
For each circuit/context, measure warm runtime and compute a reference fidelity outside the timed boundary.
Define the prediction-time family signal for strict circuit OOF and separately define family-held-out evaluation.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Inventory which existing runs have a compatible runtime-plus-quality pair.
promotion_requirements: Strong-method signature of ladder, fidelity threshold and family encoding.

scientific_contract: Do not resume the existing ten-cell pilot.
A future intervention must specify the suspected timing-instability factor, control and treatment, replication count, and acceptance rule before timing begins.
After an accepted calibration, evaluate held-out candidate-specific runtime and quality, then report candidate MAE, selector oracle-hit rate and regret separately.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Validate terminal pilot artifacts and summarize the stability evidence.
promotion_requirements: Stable calibration and at least two quality-eligible candidates per held-out circuit.

scientific_contract: Keep selected plan, workspace, precision and scalar output identical between estimate and actual contraction.
Report RUNTIME_EST / warm-contraction ratio rather than an Aer/CUDA-Q wall-clock MAE.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Aggregate paired records and verify selected-plan identity.
promotion_requirements: None for its native paired diagnostic claim; cross-engine promotion is forbidden.

scientific_contract: Use pulse program and atom layout as the input, with declared analog quality configuration.
Never map digital OpenQASM into the analog panel without a separately validated equivalence.
routine_worker_may_do_now: Audit the completed pilot and retain it as an appendix artifact.
promotion_requirements: Separate analog panel, accepted quality gate and identifiable formula fit.
